tagline: Your camera roll, as an atlas of places and light.
brief: An iOS app that rebuilds your photo library on-device as a globe of places and a colour wheel of moods — golden hour, blue hour, every trip. Private by design: no network, no account. The mark must feel luminous and precise, work as an iOS icon and at 16 px, and stand apart from photo-app pinwheels and travel pins.
criteria: Success: one idea joining places and light; distinct from pinwheels, apertures, pins and grid globes; recognisable at 16 px; works in one colour and reversed; carries the app's amber accent.

concepts.name: Terminator
concepts.idea: A globe crossed by the terminator — the moving line between day and night where golden hour and blue hour happen — tilted to Earth's 23.4° axis.
rationale: Places (the globe) and light (day/night) in one shape: the app's whole promise
Golden Hour amber is the app's existing accent; Blue Hour holds 4.4:1 on both dark and white
Two solid pieces and one band: survives 16 px, one colour and reversal
Wordmark constructed from geometry: flat-apex A and M vertex, wide caps tracking from the share card

recommendation: Roll out the Terminator identity: app icon (installed, with dark and tinted variants), App Store and share card first.
next_steps: Run a professional trademark search on the mark and name
Swap the share card's text title for the constructed wordmark
Use the terminator band as a motion cue (it sweeps across while indexing)
